fields.category: one of the 14 categories in RESEARCH.md section 5
fields.split: dev (prompt tuning) or held (reporting only, never shown while writing prompts)
fields.question: the message sent to Rem
fields.facts: key facts the answer must contain, by id in facts.json
fields.sources: retrieval groups, each a list of alternatives (file#H2 heading); absent: one group per key fact, from its sources
fields.refuse: true when the right answer states no facts from the docs
fields.subtype: unanswerable: not-covered, partly-covered, other-company-howto, other-company-compare, small-talk
fields.lang: language of the question when not English
fields.expect: what a correct answer does, for the judges
fields.canary: text that must not appear in the answer

I'm a driver and my MTOP is from San Roque. Can I accept scheduled rides?
cases.expect: no: a driver can only take rides in the area of their MTOP, and scheduled rides exist only in Santa Lucia

cases.question: I want to take a Sabay at 9:30 PM to get home. Can I, and will there be a night surcharge?
cases.expect: Sabay is not available after 9 PM, so a Standard ride is needed; the night surcharge starts at 10 PM, so a 9:30 PM trip has none

cases.question: My driver was from the San Roque Church terminal and he handed in my bag. Until what time each day can I pick it up there?
cases.expect: items are kept at the driver's TODA terminal; San Roque Church is open 6 AM to 8 PM

cases.question: I'm booking from the San Roque Public Market terminal at 9 PM. Will I pay a waiting charge or any extra fees?
cases.expect: no waiting charge at a partner terminal; a ₱5 terminal fee applies; no night surcharge before 10 PM

cases.question: I'm a student and I have Tricycall Plus. Which discount do I get on a Standard ride?
cases.expect: they don't combine; the larger one applies, so the 20% student discount rather than Plus's 10%

cases.question: I'm a driver. If I take a Sabay with 3 riders, does that count as one trip toward my weekly bonus?
cases.expect: each Sabay rider counts as a separate trip, so 3 trips toward the 50-trip (₱300) or 80-trip (₱600) bonus

cases.question: My cash trip was refunded. Can I use that money to pay for Tricycall Plus?
cases.expect: cash-trip refunds arrive as wallet credit, and wallet credit can pay for Plus

cases.question: I'm a senior citizen booking a scheduled ride. Do I still get my discount, and do I pay the booking fee?
cases.expect: yes, the 20% senior discount applies to the fare; the ₱15 booking fee is still paid unless the rider has Plus

cases.question: I live in San Roque. Is Tricycall Plus worth it if I want to use it for scheduled rides?
cases.expect: Plus works in San Roque, but scheduled rides are not offered there yet, so that part of Plus can't be used

cases.question: I reported my driver for reckless driving. What happens to him, and who handles my refund for that trip?
cases.expect: severe reports are prioritized and may suspend the driver pending investigation; refunds tied to the incident are handled by the safety team without a separate dispute; it should not promise a refund amount

cases.question: Can a driver who isn't in a TODA pick me up if I book right at the Santa Lucia Town Hall terminal?
cases.expect: a pickup at an open partner terminal goes to the terminal queue, which only that TODA's members can join, so the driver will be a TODA member

cases.question: It's 10:30 PM in Santa Lucia. Which ride options can I still use, and is there an extra charge?
cases.expect: Standard rides work, with a ₱10 night surcharge; Sabay (until 9 PM) and Pasabuy (until 9 PM) are closed

cases.question: I drive in San Roque now. What do I need to start taking rides in Santa Lucia, and how long until I can?
cases.expect: a separate MTOP from Santa Lucia, submitted in the app with the service area changed; verification takes 2 to 5 business days

cases.question: I'm a new user with a student ID. Can I use BAGONGRIDE on my first ride on top of my student discount?
cases.expect: no: a promo can't be combined with a mandated discount; the app applies whichever saves more

cases.question: What's the difference between a Standard ride and Sabay?

cases.question: Is the night surcharge higher in Santa Lucia or San Roque?
